claim.claim-text: 1. A method of making a redundantly printed security-enhanced document comprising a substrate having a general area, first variable indicia (151, 161, 166; 173; 181) printed directly or indirectly on the substrate, and different second variable indicia (152, 162, 167; 171; 182) printed directly or indirectly on the substrate, the first and the second variable indicia being hidden under a scratch-off coating, the first and the second variable indicia being imaged indicia providing information regarding an intended value of the document, the method comprising:

printing directly or indirectly on the substrate the first and the second variable indicia in the same general area of the substrate, coating the first and the second variable indicia with a scratch-off coating, and during the printing, registering and maintaining registration of the first variable indicia and the second variable indicia so as to overlap with each other.
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the first and the second variable indicia are printed in different colors.
3. The method of the preceding claim, wherein the different colors are all or some of the standard CMYK process colors.

4. The method of any of the preceding claims, further comprising printing one of the first variable indicia and the second variable indicia (151, 161, 166; 173) at least partially comprising a numeral and printing another of the first variable indicia and the second variable indicia (152, 162, 167; 171) at least partially comprising words that are representative of the numeral.
5. The method of any of claims 1-4, wherein the first and the second variable indicia are printed with different micro-patterned colors (181, 182).

6. The method of any of claims 1-5, wherein the first variable indicia (151, 161, 166) is printed using a color varying in darkness or contrast with respect to the second variable indicia (152, 162, 167), the second variable indicia being caption background indicia.

7. The method of any of claims 1-6, wherein the document has a background color or shade (172), the second variable indicia (171) is a background caption indicia of a different color or shade than the background color or shade, the first variable indicia (173) being defined by the absence of the background color or shade (172).
8. The method of any of the preceding claims, wherein the first and the second variable indicia are printed using different print heads (253, 256; 280).
9. The method of any of the preceding claims, wherein the redundantly printed security-enhanced document is a lottery ticket.
10. The method of any of the preceding claims, wherein the first variable indicia and the second variable indicia represent the same intended value of the document.
